purpose: Predeclare dispersed OOS dates before any new model-family results are inspected; this is not a result or production qualification.
exclusions: July 15-29 already inspected development comparisons and the current July oracle diagnostic cannot be counted as unseen evidence.
configuration_policy: Use registered open-source families; freeze experiment-specific horizon, targets, normalization, costs and parameters before screening. No OOS threshold search.
maturity_policy: All fitting labels must mature before their allowed fit cutoff; embargo at least the tested horizon. No earlier 5m embargo reuse for a longer horizon.
screening_rule: At least three genuinely unseen dispersed folds plus residual/ensemble-diversity evidence before family pruning; no model family permanently retired on a short window.
ranking_goal: net geometric APR under equal risk budget, interpreted with regime robustness, drawdown, worst rolling loss and capacity
